{{Ship module infobox}}

'''Beam Lasers''' are thermal energy weapons that fire continuously while the trigger is held and the weapon capacitor can sustain them. Fixed, gimballed, and turreted versions are available across several hardpoint sizes.<ref name="edcd-beam">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EDCD/coriolis-data/0db9234b5b9ce8c939ea84133d7ce336eea88e27/modules/hardpoints/beam_laser.json Coriolis data: Beam Laser records], Elite Dangerous Community Developers, commit 0db9234b5b9c, accessed 24 September 2026.</ref>

== Overview ==

Beam Lasers apply a continuous stream of thermal damage rather than the individual shots fired by a [[Pulse Laser]] or [[Burst Laser]]. Their sustained output is effective against shields, but the accompanying distributor draw and thermal load limit how long the beam can remain active. They consume no ammunition, so power distribution and heat management replace magazine capacity as the primary endurance constraints.

== Engineering ==

The conventional Beam Laser blueprint families are '''Efficient''', '''Lightweight''', '''Long Range''', '''Overcharged''', '''Short Range''', and '''Sturdy'''. Compatible secondary modifications are covered separately under [[Experimental Effects]].<ref name="inara-efficient">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/170/ Beam Laser — Efficient blueprint], INARA, accessed 24 September 2026.</ref>

Three Engineers provide Beam Laser Engineering:

=== Live-only blueprints ===

The Operations-era Live branch adds two Beam Laser blueprints that are not part of Legacy Engineering.<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Available Now], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 24 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-overloaded">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/226/ Beam Laser — Overloaded blueprint], INARA, accessed 24 September 2026.</ref>

Overloaded is a separate blueprint from conventional Overcharged Engineering. Plasma Conversion changes part of the weapon's damage from thermal to plasma while increasing power draw; exact modifiers and recipes vary by grade and belong to the individual blueprint records.<ref name="inara-overloaded" /><ref name="inara-plasma" />

== Acquisition ==

Standard Beam Laser variants are purchased through Outfitting. Available sizes, mounts, ratings, prices, and stock depend on the station and game branch.<ref name="edcd-beam" />
